composite_signatures.description: At fixed temperature and curvature history, pressure changes slip onset with membrane/contact-force response while transformation onset follows local NiTi thermomechanical state; separation must exceed channel uncertainty.
At fixed calibrated pressure-transfer range, changing curvature drives local transformation and slip patterns whose predicted sequence depends on prestrain and wire position.
Rate/temperature perturbations shift hysteresis through established thermomechanics; similar loop changes from friction, membrane or fixtures require local controls.

warning: Global M-kappa agreement or disagreement alone cannot identify a missing coupling mechanism.
